original_cohort_denominator_descriptive.note: Competing event and untraceable rows are retained in original N but are not scored as failures in the primary analysis. These rates are conservative descriptive full-cohort bounds, not the primary window metric.

repeat_vs_new_exploratory_fisher_exact.note: Exploratory only. Repeat selection is observational, samples are small, and this is not a causal comparison.

contrast_with_lifetime_layer.interpretation: The large drop from eventual peak attainment to fixed-window occupancy demonstrates why lifetime success and T+10 persistence must remain separate outcomes. Denominators differ, so this is a conceptual/descriptive contrast rather than a paired percentage-point estimator.

analysis_gate.unlock_reason: 100/100 final outcome paths; competing event and untraceable rows explicit; identity and 2021-first QA completed.

guardrails: Primary fixed-window proportions use the assessable denominator.
Competing event and untraceable are never silently converted to zero.
Exact 2021 evidence has priority over 2020/2022 fallback even when fallback carries a higher prominence score.
Lifetime peak and T+10 occupancy answer different questions.
